title: LuckRead Publish Preflight Operation
purpose: Run stateless publish-readiness checks before a creator submits content for review.

database.reason: Pure analysis; authoritative content persistence remains in D1-02.

checks: AI creation policy and required substantial creator contribution for articles
people-first/original-value signals aligned to Google Search guidance
global phone candidates across major Americas, Europe, East Asia and Southeast Asia numbering formats
phone normalization and validation using libphonenumber-js with conservative national-format fallback
platform registry detection for messenger, social, enterprise and community channels
mainstream messenger detection: WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook Messenger, WeChat, LINE, QQ, Signal, Viber, KakaoTalk, Discord

expanded channel detection: Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok, X, Reddit, Zalo, imo, BiP, Kik, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Google Chat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu/Lark, Threema, Matrix/Element, XMPP, Session, SimpleX
Unicode NFKC, zero-width, bidi-control and targeted homoglyph normalization before contact detection
external URL extraction and registrable-domain parsing using tldts
QR-code/scan text hints and media-reference heuristics

verdicts.YELLOW: Advisory issues exist; creator may continue, subject to normal moderation.
verdicts.RED: A blocking policy/quality issue exists; creator must fix it before review submission.

nonGoals: Pixel-level image OCR or QR decoding
Determining the subscriber's current telecom operator from a phone prefix
Proving that a detected phone number or messenger ID is active/owned by a person
Replacing content moderation or human review
Adding a new Worker or D1 database
Live telecom subscriber/operator ownership, HLR, SIM or portability verification
Proving that a detected social/messenger identifier is currently active or owned by a person

openSourceRuntime.normalization: Built-in NFKC + targeted UTS39-style homoglyph/zero-width handling

implementation.performance: Fast path is deterministic and stateless; external AI/OCR/intelligence remains optional and out of the synchronous v1 path.
implementation.privacy: UI exposes counts/platforms only; full phone/identifier values are masked in server findings.
